summary: The registrant, Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2016-GC37, filed a Form 8-K to report an assignment of special servicing duties under the CGCMT 2016-P3 PSA. Effective September 1, 2026, Greystone Servicing Company LLC sold and conveyed substantially all assets of its special servicing division to C-IV Asset Management LLC, which assumed all duties as special servicer. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic events were disclosed. This is a routine servicing agreement change, not a special situation.
